name: SY8089A
description: Very cheap 5.5 V, 2 A synchronous 1 MHz buck in SOT-23-5 for making 3.3 V or 1.8 V from USB 5 V or a single Li-ion cell.
notes: 5.5 V max input (6 V abs max): only for 5 V or 1S Li-ion inputs.
SY8089A (AAAC) has hiccup short-circuit protection; the SY8089 (AAC) latches off.

en.note: Do NOT float (no internal pull-up). Tie to IN for always-on: EN abs max is -0.3 V to VIN + 0.6 V (VIN abs max 6.0 V), so absMaxV 6.0 here means 'never above VIN + 0.6 V'. High > 1.5 V, low < 0.4 V. If driven by a source that goes hi-Z in shutdown while IN is on a battery, add 1 MΩ EN-GND pull-down.

notes: No BOOT pin: P-channel high-side switch (110 mOhm) + N-channel low side (80 mOhm). Internally compensated, 1 MHz fixed frequency, 100 % dropout operation.

Current limit: PFET current limit 3.5 A is a MINIMUM; the datasheet gives no typical value. SY8089A (AAAC): short circuit -> frequency folds back to ~30 % and current limit to 3.0 A (hiccup), OVP (>120 % for 20 µs) without latch-off. SY8089 (AAC) latches off instead.
Feedback: VOUT = 0.6*(1 + R1/R2), R1 = top; 10 k-1 M highly recommended for BOTH resistors. Typical app: R1 200 k / R2 100 k for 1.8 V with C1 22 pF across R1.
Feed-forward: 22 pF in parallel with R1 'may further speed up the load transient responses' and is recommended for large load steps (used in the typical app).

Inductor: L = VOUT*(1 - VOUT/VIN,MAX)/(FSW * IOUT,MAX * 40 %) (ripple ~40 % of max output current); Isat > IOUT,MAX + VOUT*(1-VOUT/VIN,MAX)/(2*FSW*L); DCR < 50 mOhm desirable. Typical app and EC conditions µse 2.2 µH. No allowed inductance range is stated.
Output cap: X5R or better, 6.3 V, greater than 22 µF (typical app 2x22 µF). No upper limit given.
Input cap: pin table says at least 10 µF ceramic; application text and typical app µse 22 µF X5R 6.3 V close to IN/GND.
VIN 2.7-5.5 V, abs max 6.0 V; UVLO max 2.5 V, 0.2 V hysteresis. Soft-start 1.2 ms. VOUT range not stated explicitly (catalog 0.6-5.5 V is consistent with VREF 0.6 V and 100 % duty).
Layout: CIN close to IN/GND, small LX copper, keep R1/R2 and FB trace away from LX; ground plane desirable.
